name: Desert Nomads
oracle_text:
Desertwalk
Prevent all damage that would be dealt to this creature by Deserts.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to this creature by Deserts.

needs.what: a `prevent_damage` static over permanents (`affects`, `prevent_all`) that reads `damage_source` -- here {"subtypes": ["Desert"]} -- so only damage from a matching dealer is prevented: `primitives.damage_permanent` must filter its total shield by the source the way `player_statics.prevented_player_damage` does for a seat
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The loader refuses `damage_source` on `prevent_damage` unless the static names `affects_player` and no `affects` -- the permanent half does not read it, so `prevent_all` over self would prevent every source's damage. `protection` from Deserts is a bigger card: it also stops the creature being blocked, targeted and enchanted by Deserts. Desertwalk itself is the shipped `desertwalk` keyword
